description: One-click PyQGIS debugging: start QGIS with the debug bridge and attach VS Code. Companion to the pyqgis-devbridge CLI.
command.launchAndAttach: Launch QGIS with debugger and attach
command.setup: Set up PyQGIS environment for this folder
config.cliCommand: The devbridge command-line tool (name on PATH, or an absolute path).
config.language: Language for DevBridge messages and the CLI. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.
config.launchTimeoutSeconds: How long to wait for QGIS to start the debug bridge.
config.showStatusBar: Show the DevBridge status bar button.
